purpose: Audit and refactor engineering-pattern thinking around hazard basis, common-mode exposure, control-room legibility, OPEX memory, and emergency information rails.

factor_axes.question: What event envelope was assumed, and what event exceeded or invalidated it?
Could operators/regulators see the system state that mattered?
Did one stressor defeat multiple barriers or units at once?
Was prior experience captured, shared, and available before recurrence?
How did urgent verified information reach other states, publics, or responders?
Did a lesson become equipment, procedure, training, inspection, regulation, or exercise?

mapped_records.hazard_basis: internal process upset plus relief-valve/instrumentation mismatch
reactor state/control-system design at low-power test conditions
external earthquake/tsunami hazard and common-mode flooding beyond design assumptions

refactor_effect: Prevents all nuclear accidents from being collapsed into one moral or technical story; makes hazard envelope, system legibility, OPEX, notification, and infusion independently queryable.
next_refactor: Extend factor axes to existing engineering records.
